description: ServerFact carries server-provided gates, receiveServerFact constructs them, and narrowServerFact lets local state withhold a gate without granting it. pendingServerFact marks a client expression that stands in for a server fact until the referenced backend ticket ships it. The shared gate fixture checks that unrelated inputs cannot change a server fact.

characterizationScenarios.name: pendingServerFact returns its value and requires a backend ticket id
Received server facts preserve their value and local state can only withhold a gate
Server-fact gates render only the fact under perturbation

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import the public fact constructors, pending marker, and gate fixture; classified consumers must declare the dependency.
pendingServerFact stays importable from every layer as the ADR-API-SERVER-FACTS-0042 marker.
